zh.title: 利雅德航空將運營轉移至阿爾卡西姆機場 恢復多條國際航線
zh.summary: 利雅德航空遷往阿爾卡西姆機場 自10月25日起恢復六條國際航班
body: 利雅德航空已將運營從利雅德的國王哈立德國際機場（RUH）轉移至阿爾卡西姆國際機場（ELQ），以在胡塞武裝襲擊後恢復航班。
根據利雅德航空，自2026年10月25日起，飛往開羅（CAI）、達卡（DAC）、吉達（JED）、倫敦希斯羅（LHR）、拉合爾（LHE）及伊斯蘭堡（ISB）的航班將從阿爾卡西姆起飛，不再使用利雅德。
航空公司將為旅客提供免費巴士接駁，從利雅德前往ELQ，車程預計超過三小時。
同日，國王哈立德國際機場宣佈將重新開放，航站樓1供國內線、航站樓2供國際線使用。
自10月10日機場遭襲擊造成12人死亡以來，RUH航班曾被暫停或受限；10月25日沙烏地政府稱攔截了10枚胡塞發射的彈道導彈。

en.title: Riyadh Air shifts operations to Al Qassim Airport, resumes multiple international routes
en.summary: Riyadh Air moves ops to Al Qassim, resumes six international routes from Oct 25
body: Riyadh Air has moved its operations away from King Khalid International Airport (RUH) in the Saudi capital to Al‑Qassim International Airport (ELQ) as the airline seeks to resume flights after Houthi attacks.
According to Riyadh Air, from 25 October 2026 flights to Cairo (CAI), Dhaka (DAC), Jeddah (JED), London‑Heathrow (LHR), Lahore (LHE) and Islamabad (ISB) will depart from Al Qassim instead of Riyadh.
The carrier will provide a complimentary coach for passengers from Riyadh to ELQ, with the journey expected to take over three hours.
On the same day, King Khalid International Airport announced it would reopen with Terminal 1 for domestic flights and Terminal 2 for international flights.

Since the 10 October attack that killed 12 people, flights from RUH have been suspended or faced government restrictions; on 25 October the Saudi government said it intercepted and destroyed ten Houthi‑launched ballistic missiles aimed at the southern region.
